definitions.explanation: Describes conditions, quality, or environments that are extremely bad or substandard. Stronger than simply 'bad' — implies conditions that are seriously inadequate or harmful.

examples.japanese: {労働|ろうどう}{環境|かんきょう}が{劣悪|れつあく}だ。
{劣悪|れつあく}な{品質|ひんしつ}の{製品|せいひん}が{出回|でまわ}っている。
examples.english: Inferior quality products are circulating in the market.

examples.japanese: {衛生|えいせい}{状態|じょうたい}が{劣悪|れつあく}な{地域|ちいき}では{病気|びょうき}が{広|ひろ}がりやすい。
examples.english: Disease spreads easily in areas with terrible sanitary conditions.

notes:
A strong, somewhat formal word typically used to criticize conditions or quality — especially in discussions of labor, living conditions, and product quality. Not typically used to describe people directly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{劣悪|れつあく}な{環境|かんきょう} (terrible environment)
・{劣悪|れつあく}な{条件|じょうけん} (terrible conditions)
・{劣悪|れつあく}な{品質|ひんしつ} (inferior quality)
・{劣悪|れつあく}な{待遇|たいぐう} (terrible treatment)
